title: Owner-scoped personal home tasks and read-only source news

crossYearFixture.description: 2025/2026 execution dates preserve separate completion records. January feedback includes current/prior years independently; empty current-year feedback falls back at most one year. Old records remain visible without NEW. Keys/links preserve actual year/version; coverage provides actual OrderWeek, absent week stays null. Partial year failure preserves successful results.

dnspyEvidence.source: Personal tasks/read marks are independent owner-scoped server files, not nenova.exe ERP actions. Source news reuses existing readKnowledge/loadQuality read functions and source permission predicates; no new SQL or ERP mutation.

storage: data/runtime/personal-home/{sha256(authenticated userId)}.json; owner.json mutex metadata (pid/hostname/token/createdAt), exclusive temp file, fsync and atomic rename, expectedRevision CAS, idempotent requestId/payload hash. Same-host lock recovery requires process.kill(pid,0) ESRCH and a recovery mutex; verified dead directory is atomically quarantined, only lock metadata cleaned. Missing/unknown/live/foreign-host locks fail closed with administrator guidance; release checks ownership token. 16 MiB file, lifetime maximum 5000 rules (not daily executions), 20000 retained mutation request IDs, 500 most recent read markers.
ownership: req.user.userId alone selects storage; optional expectedOwnerId only detects account races and mismatch rejects before any read/write. No delegation/ownerId input.
occurrences: weekdays=[] means once, [0..6] means daily, subset means selected weekdays. GET has no mutation. Completion/archive/restore target POST date=original occurrenceDate; archived rows remain available with archived=true. Update changes selected occurrence title and applies future schedule after max(selected date,current KST date), preserving prior calendar records. stop ends future recurrence after that boundary. Pagination oldest-first: limit default200/max500, offset, totalTasks, nextOffset. Dates 2000-01-01 through 2100-12-31. A recurring rule whose start-date weekday is unselected first occurs on the next matching selected weekday, not necessarily its start date. Schedule segments are counted arithmetically; snapshot/complete/archive overrides adjust prefix counts, then binary search and a bounded heap produce only the requested page without materializing all historical occurrences.
feeds: Valid CHECK and CURRENT knowledge remains visible regardless of age, important-first/latest order, limit20. Authorized feedback remains visible regardless of age: current reporting year latest20; include prior year during the January seven-day boundary, or fallback exactly one prior year when current-year valid cases are empty. No unbounded history scan; actual OrderYear/OrderWeek and year-specific sourceKey/link are preserved. Seven days determines isRecent; isNew requires isRecent and unread, while unread independently tracks source revision. 25-second yearly loadQuality cache with in-flight dedupe; failures not cached. Per-year failures retain successful year results and expose feedErrors; failed current-year reads do not trigger empty-year fallback. Source errors never block personal task saves. read accepts only an item in the current authorized feed; no source mutation.
api: GET date/offset/limit/expectedOwnerId; POST action=create|update|complete|archive|restore|stop|read,expectedRevision,requestId,date,taskId,title,startDate,weekdays,done,sourceKey,expectedOwnerId. Authenticated active users; private no-store; same-origin check on POST. Response ownerId/date/revision/tasks/totalTasks/nextOffset/guidance/feedback/feedErrors/syncedAt. Only personal files mutate.
feedDetails: Guidance CHECK=확인 필요 and CURRENT=현재 지침; RETIRED excluded; source isKnowledgeId validates IDs. details preserves situation/action/caution/checklist/contact/reviewDate, newline text up to4000. Feedback statusLabel reuses QUALITY_STATUSES; details farms/products/sources[{orderYear,orderWeek,productName,farmName}], relatedSources[same], caseFarm/caseProduct from anchor coverage or case, problem from actual Title, request from provided recent REQUEST only, latestBody/dueDate/recentEvents. Confirm all grouped sources only for exactly one matching case and one inbox matching case.InboxKey, excluding isNew rows; otherwise use exact year+SourceKey anchor. Ambiguous/unlinked group rows belong only to relatedSources labelled individual history linkage unconfirmed. Unique sources by year/week/farm/product, never Title as product. Ticker summary max300: confirmed grouped names preserved when fitting, overflow names use 외N개 and explicit ellipsis; ambiguous groups anchor names only; actual problem/latest; full details bounded by original4000 text limits. Combined feed JSON UTF8 budget1MiB: oldest WHOLE detail objects replaced with {}, detailsTruncated=true and detailNotice directing to preserved source href; never silently cut names or bodies. Existing20items/feed and authorization/year/read/recent rules retained, no extra SQL or writes.
